scope: One fictional catering-workflow film; subjective sample evidence, not a model ranking.

patterns.source_requirement: Visible mouse, fingers supported on buttons, neutral wrist, gaze already aimed into screen in source still.
patterns.failed: Generic screen-focused gaze plus breathing/blink still let Kling raise the eyes in before_v1.
patterns.improved: Lowered chin and downward pupils, screen below eye level, no head lift, near-still breathing with tiny click improved before_v2.
patterns.caution: Inspect chronological moving frames: written constraints never prove the actual eye line.

patterns.source_requirement: Supported closed box, simple two-hand lid-edge contact, downward box-directed gaze, same identity and clothes.
patterns.selected: after_v1; hand settling and a modest shift to the box edge were coherent even though stricter immobility was requested.
patterns.caution: Complex packing choreography was unnecessary. End wipe covers final hand withdrawal.

patterns.pattern: Retain the same order-card nodes across reflow; keep exact counts, names and packing note traceable. Carry completion badge into human payoff, then close with the opening quantity.
